### Observed differences

- Activity A01 was absent from the earlier window (0 of 200 traces) and appears in every trace in the later window, about 2.1 times per trace on average, occurring more than once per trace in roughly 53 in 100 traces; its first occurrence sits early in the trace (median relative position about a quarter in). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the later window, A02 and A09 each lead exclusively to A01, whereas before they split their outgoing transitions roughly half–half between A03 and A12 (A02 about 49%/52%, A09 about 45%/55%). A08 now leads to A01 on about half of its outgoing transitions, where before it always led to A13. [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004]
- A01's outgoing transitions go to A12 (about 53%) and A03 (about 47%). Distances between the pre-existing activities shifted about one position later: A02→A03 pairs within five steps were mostly 1–2 positions apart before (about 42% at 1, 44% at 2) and are 2–3 positions apart after (about 48% at 2, 53% at 3), with the same one-step stretch for A02→A12, A09→A03 and A09→A12. [DIR001, LAG001, LAG004, LAG011, LAG014]
- Pairs involving A01 flip from "never together" to "always together": A01 now co-occurs with A02, A03 and A12 in every trace (before, A01 never appeared while the others did), and it co-occurs with A08 in about 34 in 100 traces and with A13 in about 17 in 100. [REL001, REL002, REL005, REL003, REL004, REL006]
- The A13 branch shrank and re-routed: A13 now always leads to A08 (before, about 54% to A12 and 46% to A03), A13's trace participation fell from about 38 to about 17 in 100 traces, and its co-occurrence with A02, A03, A12 and A08 dropped from about 38% to about 17%. A08's participation changed little (about 38% to 34%). [DIR005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL003]
- A08 and A13 now also repeat within the same trace at short distances in the later window; the corresponding before-profiles rest on very few observations (about 5 traces each). [LAG008, LAG017, LAG019]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that A01 was added to the process and placed between the upstream activities A02 and A09 (and, on about half of its outgoing transitions, A08) and the downstream activities A03 and A12. In the earlier window A02 and A09 led directly to A03 or A12, each roughly half–half; in the later window both lead exclusively to A01, which hands over to A12 (about 53%) or A03 (about 47%), and every measured distance from A02 or A09 downstream moved about one position later, consistent with A01 sitting in between. The change is shown directly rather than only through frequencies: A01 runs from absent to present in all 200 after-traces with about 2.1 occurrences per trace, the transitions into and out of A01 are observed on the edges themselves, and the A01–A02, A01–A03 and A01–A12 relations flip from never co-occurring to always co-occurring. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR002, DIR004, REL001, REL002, REL005, LAG001, LAG004, LAG011, LAG014]

The volume of qualifying evidence (39 items against roughly 0.31 expected if nothing had changed) cannot be explained by sampling variation as a whole. What the evidence cannot rule out is that A13's reduced participation is an independent routing change rather than a consequence of A01's addition; also, positions and lags are measured in event positions, so the placement claim holds in ordering terms only, not in clock time. [REL006, DIR005]

Other differences: A13 now always leads to A08 and A08 splits its outgoing transitions between A01 (about 51%) and A13 (about 49%), where before A08 always led to A13; A08 and A13 additionally repeat within traces at short distances in the later window, though the before-side of those repetition profiles rests on only about 5 traces each. [DIR003, DIR005, LAG008, LAG017, LAG019]
